title: Motor semantics, mass factorial, and bounded leg actuator research round 3
rawStorage: Local workspace outside repository; no verified remote raw-data backup. Compact results and reproduction source committed.

protocol.geometry: Fixed anchor and 6 kg isotropic cube, local/world Z revolute at COM; no fixed collider, contacts, gravity, body damping or sleep.
protocol.actualTorqueDefinition: Iz * (omegaZ_after - omegaZ_before) / native timestep: mean net native motor+constraint torque over one step; no instantaneous torque claim.
protocol.api: RevoluteImpulseJoint.configureMotor(targetPos,targetVel,k,d), ForceBased. Axis supplied to JointData.revolute is local Z; rawAxis is the native joint coordinate, not world Z index.
protocol.limits: Position-error cap is reproduced, not a motor max-force API. Numeric inputs are engineering diagnostics, not human strength. Fixed-anchor reactions lie outside the dynamic-body energy boundary; whole-body launch cause and a game fix are not established.

protocol.scope: Identical matched low-down checkpoint and catchLoad control. Replay both branches to frame772 with matching native snapshot and scalar/vector/joint/gait/body prefix hashes. Only future zero-coefficient upright requests are truly disabled in the late branch.
protocol.captureDefinition: Explicit dynamic body/anchor transforms, velocities, mass/inertia; fighter/gait/skill own scalar/vector/plain fields; joint targets/prevRV/gain/anchors. Excludes methods, arbitrary class instances and WASM wrapper pointers; complete native state is separately hashed.
protocol.caution: Energy differences include unmeasured native motor/contact work. Momentum residual is not an energy supply measurement. No recovery acceptance claimed.

result.acceptance: not assessed; isolated diagnostic interventions, not game changes
result.energyCaution: Delta(K+MgCOM.y) includes changing mass/inertia; native motor/contact work unresolved.

gaitIsolation.scope: Shared original THREE/config/contact modules; all copied Gait method implementations replace observed dispatch only after matched native checkpoint, preserving ledger wrappers. Candidate update execution is mandatory. Contact-only adds AND !actual.hasSupport solely to air; load candidates also select/defer/preload catch during levH>0.

details.scope: Installation plus 24 steps checks dispatch/finite actuator operation, not recovery or gait acceptance. Recreated passive constraints and contacts remain outside the actuator cap.

tests.name: actual gait resetRates suppresses first target-velocity feedforward and resumes it on the next update

details.scope: Real Fighter.driveJoints and Gait.resetRates with synthetic target jumps; checks controller history semantics, not whole-body recovery.

result.scope: Isotropic COM fixtures measure actuator angular impulse; free-pair implicit inverse inertia is an approximation. Passive constraints/contact reactions and other game actuators are not globally torque-bounded. Synthetic inputs and numerical tolerances are not human strength limits.

result.definition: One-step projected relative angular response to paired torque impulses in the actual standing chain. Contacts, upper native motors, upright motor and passive constraints remain coupled. This is not intrinsic inertia or a human material-property estimate.
result.forcePolicy: After ordinary preparation and six leg joint recreation, resetForces(true) and resetTorques(true) on every dynamic world body once, then take the shared native snapshot. Every branch restores that exact snapshot; gravity and native motor settings stay fixed.
